purpose: Post-hoc diagnostic on the same five confirmation scenes; no retraining or policy change.
matching: Same-class one-to-one maximum cardinality then total IoU, IoU >= 0.50. IDs are zero-based within scene and class.
quota: In each scene/class/mode copy the exact list of selected strong objects and the number and positions of auxiliary slots from the frozen policy, before scoring against references.
area_only: Positive-area same/dual candidates of the same class with max IoU <0.80 against ALL strong polygons of that class. No learned probability floor. Sort descending by projected area, stable same then dual source order, greedy within-class NMS suppressing IoU >=0.40. Take the quota.
area_after_frozen_admission: Keep the frozen score floor and frozen score-ordered NMS winners. Reorder those survivors by descending area, breaking ties in frozen rank order, then take the same quota. This comparison isolates the final within-class ordering among surviving candidates.
